PolynomialGaloisGroups' remainder is elementary finite-group and polynomial algebra sitting directly on landed files (Partition, WreathProduct, TransitiveGroupLabel, Discriminant, FactorDegrees), whereas AdicSpaces still has to build the structure sheaf with stalks and pre-adic spaces, Tate acyclicity, the whole category of adic spaces with gluing, and then the Fargues-Fontaine curve A_inf/Y_F/X_F = Y_F/phi^Z - Layers 5 and 6 have not been started at all.

AdicSpaces needs four remaining layers of one well-trodden route (Wedhorn 8.x sheafiness, adic spaces, then the FF curve) with no external imports and Layers 0-2 largely landed; ArithmeticStatistics has no stage built and must construct the invariant theory of binary forms and every orbit parametrization, Davenport's lattice-point lemma with error, cusp and Ekedahl uniformity, Davenport-Heilbronn and the Bhargava-Shankar average, while importing weak Mordell-Weil/descent (RP.1), curves and models (SF.3/SF.4) and the large sieve (SV.2), none of which is built.

Both are six unbuilt stages over partly built classical foundations, but ArithmeticStatistics starts from Weil heights with Northcott, Minkowski lattice-point asymptotics and TauCeti's Mordell-Weil theorem with an explicit 2-Selmer group, while AdditiveCombinatorics has nothing above Mathlib's elementary sumset/Plunnecke-Ruzsa/Roth layer: Gowers norms, the whole nilmanifold and nilsequence theory with the Green-Tao-Ziegler inverse theorem, the transference machinery and linear equations in primes are three successive research-scale bodies with zero declarations, and it must also supply the prime number theorem and the Brun/Selberg/large-sieve stack up to SV.3.

AdditiveCombinatorics' bottom two stages are largely in Mathlib/Combinatorics/Additive already, and its imports are one sieve/analytic chain; AdicSpacesPartII must first finish tauceti AdicSpaces Layers 3-6 (stalks, Tate acyclicity, adic spaces, the FF curve) and then build formal schemes with formal GAGA, analytification with proper GAGA, admissible generic fibres, Kiehl coherence and traces, the etale/pro-etale sites from AdicEtaleGeometry A1, sousperfectoid families resting on almost mathematics and almost purity (PerfectoidSpaces P0/P3), and dagger geometry - a deeper stack with nothing of it in the baseline.
